recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, horizontal stack of currency secured by a white and yellow paper band, set against a flat, vibrant red field. The top bill is partially peeled back to reveal a custom illustration underneath, while the entire object casts a soft, dark shadow to the left.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject isolated against a high-contrast monochromatic field
Horizontal object orientation vs vertical text alignment on the band
Realistic object textures vs flat graphic background
Soft drop shadow providing depth to a 2D composition
coreInvariants: Soft, directional shadow to the left
Paper currency texture with aged off-white tones

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered horizontally and slightly above the vertical midline; occupies approximately 40% of the frame width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The currency stack with its high-contrast detail against the red void.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the center stack, moves to the peeled corner detail, then drops to the bottom-left and bottom-right corners for metadata.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive flat red space surrounding the subject to emphasize isolation and importance.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation background vs low saturation, high detail subject.

letterConstructionRules: Wide tracking for legibility at small scales
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different weights or positions for consistency.
graphicDevices: Currency band with vertical text orientation

candidateDirections.reason: Clean, modern geometric appearance matching the contemporary aesthetic.
Open counters and geometric structure suitable for small metadata text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a flat, vibrant red background. In the center, place a realistic stack of hundred-dollar bills secured by a white paper band with yellow edges. The top bill should be curled back at the right corner to reveal a line-art illustration of praying hands on the bill underneath. Cast a soft, dark shadow from the stack towards the left side.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of small, white, all-caps geometric sans-serif text in the bottom-left corner with wide tracking. Place a standard black and white rectangular advisory badge in the bottom-right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, untextured red?
Is the currency stack horizontal and centered?
Does the shadow fall to the left of the object?
Is the text in the bottom-left corner small and all-caps?

adjustableVariables: Illustration revealed under the peeled corner
mustRedesign: Specific logos on the currency band
Exact wording of the metadata text

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp edges on the subject

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red is vibrant and not muddy.
Check that the shadow looks natural and soft.
Verify the text is legible but unobtrusive.
Confirm the peeled corner effect looks three-dimensional.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject [Isolated Object] + Background [Flat Vibrant Color] + Lighting [Soft Leftward Shadow] + Typography [Minimalist Sans-Serif Metadata] = Modern Minimalist Cover Aesthetic
